title: Romance Advice I Wish My Parents Taught Me: the Medium windows
intro: The whole article as it reads now. You said you don’t like the Medium windows, so I took on the 21 sections that had one, the way your fix of “Talk about making love before you do it” did (your fix is in). With my fixes, 19 read Human High in every window, each section checked by itself. Ten of them are in the article, the fixes of its model text; the other nine change your versions from the fourth page, or a line you kept there, so they are the cards below, each needing your decision. Two sections still read Medium or worse, and are here as questions: a line from you on each helps. Every paragraph, picture and video is here in order: nothing is left out.

suggestions.title: “Then what? You block her?”

edits.before: That’s honest about what you want tonight, but don't forget that tonight is enough time to make a baby. If this girl gets pregnant, she’s gonna call you. Then what? You block her? Agree to child support? Try to convince her to abort if she thinks abortion is killing her child? My first girlfriend, a diehard Baptist, aborted our child and told me a year later, because she “didn’t want to trap” me. I'm still shocked and saddened about that, 20 years later (assuming it was true). This is what penetrative sex can do. No contraception is perfect.
edits.after: That’s honest about what you want tonight, but don't forget that tonight is enough time to make a baby. If this girl gets pregnant, she’s gonna call you, and then what? suggestions.title: “With H., I learned”

edits.before: H. taught me another part of the same dyad problem. I learned not to treat what either of us thought the relationship was as a guarantee of what it would remain, because feelings can and usually do change over time. In our case, the relationship continued to naturally deepen while our outside relationships often felt more shallow, so it was natural for the dependency to increase. She was never into monogamy, but that didn’t stop her from becoming possessive once she found someone really worth keeping. And then she began demonizing me when I refused to be possessed. Because we did not have a shared community capable of supporting us, her friends heard her side and affirmed her truth. The accusations couldn’t have survived among people who knew us both.
